<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>A 4bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier. Consists of two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="size">Size parameter for the multiplier.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="add_reg" width_description="[7:0]" description="Register to hold intermediate sums during addition."></reg>
        <reg id="partial_product" width_description="[7:0]" description="Register to hold intermediate partial products during multiplication."></reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Extending inputs by adding 'size' zeros at MSB positions.
        genvar i;
        wire [7:0] mul_a_ext;
        assign mul_a_ext = {4'd0,mul_a};
        
        wire [7:0] mul_b_ext;
        assign mul_b_ext = {4'd0,mul_b};
        
        // Multiplying each bit of the multiplier with the multiplicand and shifting accordingly.
        generate
            for(i = 0;i<size;i=i+1)begin : mul_gen_loop
                wire [7:0] temp_partial_product;
                
                if(mul_b[i]==1'b1) begin
                    assign temp_partial_product = mul_a_ext << i;
                end
                else begin
                    assign temp_partial_product = 'd0;
                end
                
                // Adding the current partial product to the register holding the previous sums.
                always @(posedge clk,negedge rst_n) begin
                    if(!rst_n) begin
                        partial_product <= 'd0;
                    end
                    else begin
                        partial_product <= temp_partial_product + partial_product;
                    end
                end
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Storing the sum in the register after one clock cycle.
        always @(posedge clk,negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                add_reg <= 'd0;
            end
            else begin
                add_reg <= partial_product;
            end
        end
        
        // Calculating the final product based on the stored sum in the register.
        always @(posedge clk,negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 'd0;
            end
            else begin
                mul_out <= add_reg;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
